review.reviewBody: I have made this recipe several times and it always gets compliments. I prefer cooking up the hard chickpeas (over the canned) as I think the texture is better and there is also less sodium. A little more time consuming but they cook up in less than an hour. I also prefer cherry tomatos cut in half. Great flavors in this one.....

This is so fresh tasting and deliciuos! I used the dried chickpeas because I did not want mushy beans. I brought them to a boil and let them sit for an hour vs. soaking over night, rinsed them, and simmered them for two hours. I used a pint of grape tomatoes each cut in half and a half cup of kalamato olives cut into fourths. I plan to make this several times a year and will cook the beans ahead of time and freeze them to save time.

I mostly followed the recipe, certainly in spirit if not in every detail. As always I used dried chickpeas that I soaked and cooked ahead of time (the bean broth makes a great substitute for chicken broth in other recipes). Also, I used fresh arugula instead of parsley, and added cucumber as others have suggested. A couple of suggestions: 1) Instead of throwing all the ingredients into a bowl and mixing them, put the lemon juice and garlic in first, add a dollop of Dijon mustard as an emulsifier, and slowly whisk in the olive oil to make a vinaigrette. It makes for a more consistent dressing, and you can adjust the amount needed for your other ingredients before adding them. 2) By all means chill before serving. But remember that olive oil tends to solidify and turn greasy if too cold, so remove from the fridge 30 minutes ahead, and give the salad a toss with a slotted spoon just before serving. In any case my wife loved it, and we've had the leftovers a couple of times since.
I added cook spinach to the salad, warmed it up a bit and added some turmeric, cumin and garman marsala. Loved it.

I made this super quick & easy recipe over & over again.Just love chickpeas!Instead of canned beans,I always boil the hard chickpeas till cooked as this taste a lot better and u can cook them in a big batch,and store in the fridge for future use.For this recipe,I used 2 cups of cooked beans and added extra lemon juice. I sometimes add a handful of fresh chopped mint and a 1/4 green bell peppers,diced just for variation.This salad is very filling and yes,it looks pretty & appetizing :)

easy delicious recipe! I used yellow sunburst cherry tomatoes, and yellow onion. Fresh basil, parsley, thyme, and oregano all from my garden. I also used olive oil and red wine vinegar instead of lemon juice.
Delicious chickpea salad. I added a cut up plum tomato & cucumber. Marinating overnight made it even better!
I like to toast the chickpeas over a bit of oil then add cumin to coat.

My husband and I really like this. I made it with parsley, exactly as written the first time. Made it again with cilantro, because I didn't have fresh parsley. We liked it both ways, but I added 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar and some fresh spinach to the cilantro version because the dressing didn't seem strong enough. I think the cilantro may have a stronger flavor than the parsley, and it needed more flavor in the dressing.
Great recipe. I didn't have any fresh parsley so I had to use dried. I also added a chopped yellow pepper and 1 cup cooked quinoa. Will make again!
I added black olives, capers, spring onions and feta cheese. Delicious!

I’ve made this a couple times. I am obsessed! The first time, I only used one can of chick peas and I also used lemon zest. It was fabulous. I also added cucumber. I liked it better with double the dressing.
Delicious. I just added an extra tomato since mine were rather small. will definitely make again and again!
Made the recipe with no modifications. Pretty good. I intend to make it again.
Made this for my daughter who is away at college and struggles with meal planning. Now I’m cursed with making it every week lol. Didn’t change a thing Great as is.
I miss Banana Blondie's comic YouTube take on this refreshing salad but glad the recipe is still at large. Simple and tasty and healthful.
I added celery, black olives, cucumbers, feta cheese. I am in love with this! Super Easy & delicious
I've made this recipe many times really really like it but I do add a tablespoon of red wine vinegar dressing to kind of up the flavor profile
